text:
alejandro: Seeing a customer escalation — 3 different tenants reporting p95/p99 jumps since 12:18 UTC. Ingress queues growing ~6x, admission rejections spiking. Full stack p99 from 350ms -> 2.4s. :warning:

oncall-bot: alert: ingress-latency-high for cluster us-west-2 (12:20 UTC) -- active alerts: ingress_queue_depth, admission_reject_rate

mia: Any config changes or deploys around that time?

alejandro: No infra deploys in that window per deploy-bot. Noticed increased 401s from billing-service on auth checks starting ~12:15. Customer SDKs seeing retry storms. Looks correlated.

lina-support: Customer report attached: "Requests frequently time out, sometimes 502, sometimes very slow responses. This started after we rotated API keys ~12:10." They also sent sample request ids: req_8f3a, req_8f3b, req_8f3c.

ben-eng: If billing auth is returning 401/5xx, our ingress will retry and pile up. We should throttle retries at the auth layer and add short-circuit fallback to cached-allow for known good tokens while we triage. Short term: increase admission concurrency cap for Dedicated pools for affected tenants to drain queues.

samir: Quick telemetry: admission->queue_depth for tenant acme-inc rose from 12 -> 75 concurrent queued requests. Concurrency limit hit and we started returning 429s at 12:22. Also saw a spike in client retries (x3-x5).

mia: Can we get a repro? Lina, can you paste the failing curl and the auth header they rotated? (no secrets)

lina-support: Repro snippet from customer (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hello"}'
```
Response often: 401 JSON {"error":"invalid_auth"} or occasionally 502.

alejandro: From logs: billing-service auth-check endpoint returning intermittent 502 and 401 for previously valid tokens due to a caching bug after the key rotation. The retry path in ingress doesn't have jitter/backoff and we end up with thundering requests to the worker pool.

ben-eng: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply ingress rate-limiter patch to add exponential jitter on auth failure retries (temp) 2) bump admission concurrency for affected tenants from 16 -> 32 for 20m to drain backlog 3) enable cached allow-path for tokens validated in last 5m 4) ask billing to rollback problematic cache invalidation.

samir: I'm running the admission bump now for tenants: acme-inc, beta-llc. Command: `./opsctl admission set-concurrency --tenant acme-inc --concurrency 32 --ttl 20m`

oncall-bot: action: admission concurrency updated for acme-inc -> 32 (by samir) at 12:31 UTC

mia: Can we add a quick guard to stop retries from clients that see 401? Maybe respond 401 without retry suggestion to SDKs?

ben-eng: We can add a short-circuit for repeated immediate 401s: if same token gets 2x 401 within 30s, return 401 and include header `Retry-After: 60` to prevent aggressive retries. Pushing a small config now.

samir: Patch queued to canary; will roll to us-west after smoke pass.

alejandro: Observability after actions: queue depth starting to fall at 12:36, admission rejects dropped to baseline by 12:42, p99 back to ~480ms and trending down.

lina-support: Customer update sent: "We identified issue related to token rotation and temporary retries; we've applied a mitigation and are monitoring. Will confirm when latency normalizes." :thumbsup:

ben-eng: Postmortem actions (short): 1) add jitter/backoff to ingress retry logic (prod fix) 2) add token validation cache health check in billing-service 3) SDK: suppress immediate retry on 401 for 60s 4) run chaos test for billing cache invalidation scenarios.

mia: Who owns follow-ups? ben-eng for ingress retry fix, billing team for cache health, SDK team for retry behavior, support to confirm customer affected are stable.

samir: I'll leave the concurrency bump active for 30m more and then revert. Setting reminder.

alejandro: Thanks team. Will open an incident doc and link it to this thread. If latency creeps again, ping me directly.

lina-support: Customer confirm at 12:52 UTC: "Latency returned to normal, thanks." Closing ticket once postmortem drafted.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-5047 (assigned: ben-eng)

ben-eng: Quick note: logs attached for req_8f3a show repeated auth-check 502 -> worker queueing -> eventual 429. Saved to /logs/incidents/INC-2026-5047/req_8f3a.log

mia: Great work. Marking as resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
